QuestInfo.name: [Grand Athenaeum] Shadow Alchemist
QuestInfo.0: Everything about Shadowvale is a lie. The world, the town, and the people exist only as figments of imagination. The missions they carry out are nothing more than a farce. Only the clear brilliance of moonlight can wash away the lies.
